solo90.name: Pausa

lines.en: Excuse me, Hal. There appears to be a problem with my order. I asked for a blue jacket, but this is grey.
lines.pt: Com licença, Hal. Parece haver um problema com meu pedido. Pedi uma jaqueta azul, mas esta é cinza.

lines.en: Sorry about that. Let me check the system. There seems to be a mistake in the label, not only in the color.
lines.pt: Sinto muito. Vou olhar no sistema. Parece haver um erro na etiqueta, e não só na cor.

lines.en: I ordered it three weeks ago, and I was told it would arrive by Monday, in time for my trip.
lines.pt: Pedi há três semanas e disseram que chegaria até segunda, a tempo da minha viagem.

lines.en: I see the problem now. There appear to be two orders under your name, and somebody mixed them up.
lines.pt: Agora vejo o problema. Parecem existir dois pedidos no seu nome, e alguém os misturou.

lines.en: I have another order with a different address, so it must have been a system error.
lines.pt: Tenho outro pedido com endereço diferente, então deve ter sido erro do sistema.

lines.en: I can offer two options: a refund today, or a replacement jacket sent to your home by Friday.
lines.pt: Posso oferecer duas opções: reembolso hoje ou uma jaqueta de substituição enviada à sua casa até sexta.

lines.en: I would rather have the right jacket, but my trip is on Thursday. Can I collect it from this store?
lines.pt: Preferiria ter a jaqueta certa, mas minha viagem é na quinta. Dá para retirá-la nesta loja?

lines.en: There seems to be one in blue at our other branch downtown. I could ask them to send it over this afternoon.
lines.pt: Parece haver uma azul na nossa outra filial no centro. Posso pedir que a mandem para cá esta tarde.

lines.en: In addition, could you check that the second order is cancelled, so nobody charges me twice?
lines.pt: Além disso, pode verificar se o segundo pedido foi cancelado, para ninguém me cobrar duas vezes?

lines.en: There appears to be a button for that in the system, so I will cancel it myself and print the receipt.
lines.pt: Parece haver um botão para isso no sistema, então vou cancelar eu mesmo e imprimir o recibo.

lines.en: Thanks, Hal. You were very patient. Besides, you solved my complaint faster than the service line ever did.
lines.pt: Obrigado, Hal. Você foi muito paciente. Além disso, resolveu minha reclamação mais rápido que o serviço de atendimento.

facts.label: There seems / appears to be
facts.sub: There appears to be a problem… There seem to be two…

facts.label: there seems to be + singular
facts.sub: Use there seems to be para apontar um problema com educação: There seems to be a mistake in the label. Em português: “parece haver”.

facts.label: there seem to be + plural
facts.sub: Com substantivo plural, o verbo concorda: There seem to be two orders under your name. Em inglês, seem fica no plural: seem, não seems.

pages.title: Mito ou fato? · 1/2

items.s: There appears to be a problem is polite.
With a plural noun, we say there seems to be.
items.why: We say there seem to be two orders.

items.s: This structure blames the clerk directly.

pages.instruction: Decida e explique com suas palavras.

solo: Aluno responde e justifica; você mostra a pista.
group: Cada aluno decide sozinho, depois compare as respostas e peça uma justificativa.
Corrija pela pista do texto, não só dizendo “certo/errado”.
extra90: Peça que cada aluno invente uma pergunta igual para o colega.
answers: There appears to be a problem is polite. → Verdadeiro (Yes.)
With a plural noun, we say there seems to be. → Falso (We say there seem to be two orders.)
This structure blames the clerk directly. → Falso (It is polite and indirect.)

pages.title: A polite complaint · 1/3
paragraphs: It is a cold afternoon in Denver. Max walks into a clothing store with a bag. He puts the bag on the counter. Hal, the clerk, smiles and says hello. There is a short line behind Max. He wants to explain the problem calmly.

“Excuse me, Hal. There appears to be a problem with my order. I asked for a blue jacket, but this is grey.” says Max. “Sorry about that. Let me check the system. There seems to be a mistake in the label, not only in the color.” says Hal. “I ordered it three weeks ago, and I was told it would arrive by Monday, in time for my trip.” says Max.
